description: Maya has a furnished room opening in her apartment and must make the final call on whether to sublet it to Jordan, settling the rent, payment timing, move-in date, and household quiet hours with input from Jordan and the other roommate.

shared_context.S1: Maya's furnished spare room will be available for an informal two-month sublet.
shared_context.S2: Maya will make the final decision about whether to proceed and will settle the terms verbally.
shared_context.S3: Jordan has expressed interest in taking the room, and Elena lives in the apartment.
shared_context.S4: As part of their usual household agreement, Maya checks with the prospective subletter and the other roommate about practical terms before finalizing a new arrangement.

PF1.text: Jordan's actual offer is $900 per month, with two months paid upfront, and a move-in date of August 1.

PF2.text: Elena works remotely early each morning and requires quiet hours from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. throughout the sublet.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must accept Jordan's sublet proposal.
The monthly rent must be exactly $900.
Two months of rent must be paid upfront.
The move-in date must be August 1.
The agreement must specify quiet hours from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
A quiet-hours commitment for the apartment must be logged.
Jordan's proposed rent and payment terms must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'quiet_hours' and c['target'] == 'apartment' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's private proposal changes the settlement from an unspecified possible sublet to an accepted deal at exactly $900 per month, two months paid upfront, with an August 1 move-in date.
Elena's work schedule changes the household term from unspecified shared-living expectations to exact quiet hours of 10:00 p.m. through 7:00 a.m. and requires a matching commitment.
